question: List the names of singers who have never performed in a concert.
reference_sql: SELECT s.Name FROM singer AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM singer_in_concert AS sic WHERE sic.Singer_ID = s.Singer_ID)
candidate_sql:
SELECT s.Name
FROM singer AS s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM singer_in_concert AS sic
    WHERE TRY_CAST(sic.Singer_ID AS BIGINT) = s.Singer_ID
);
